title: 棍的世界（The World of Sticks）
description: This project modifies the text and textures in Minecraft. It changes them to text and images related to '电棍 otto' streamers on the Chinese internet.
body:
# 棍的世界


<details>
<summary>中文版介绍</summary>

“棍的世界”是一个我的世界资源包，它在游戏中做出了一些有关中文互联网上“电棍 otto”主播的梗，以此让我的世界变得更加好笑。

</details>

<details>
<summary>English version introduction</summary>

"The World of Sticks" is a Minecraft resource pack of mine. It incorporates some memes from Chinese internet about the streamer 'Electric Stick Otto' in the game, making Minecraft even funnier.

</details>
